# HUSS HQ — Recent updates
**11 November 2026 • 1/4 — Members & recruitment**

**Verification and tickets**
• Member and ally verification now use screenshots sent privately to the bot, with staff reviewing requests through the server panel.
• Approved applicants receive a separate private ticket for additional questions.
• New member approvals automatically include an **Open onboarding** button in both the approval DM and the private ticket.

**Onboarding is available THIS WAR**
Use `/onboarding view` for verification, interests, squad membership, qualifications and your first operation signup. Progress is checked when you open or refresh it. Choose interests yourself; optional steps can be skipped. Onboarding does not automatically grant ranks, qualifications or squad membership.

**Your war hub and dashboard**
• `/hub view` brings together accessible stockpiles, orders, recruiting squads and upcoming events.
• `/me` shows your squads, work, shipments, events, training and pending requests. Private information stays filtered by your access.

**Feedback and absence notices**
• `/feedback submit` sends a private bug report or suggestion. Track it with `/feedback mine` or read the full report with `/feedback view`.
• `/absence set` records your expected return date for officer review. You must still respond to activity checks; absence is not an automatic rollover exemption.

**Operation reminders**
Choose channel reminders, DMs or no personal reminder with `/hub reminders`. Reminder buttons let you **Confirm attendance**, mark **Running late**, or **Withdraw**. These update your RSVP, not proof of attendance.

**TTS is available**
Use `/tts join`, then type in the voice channel’s chat to speak through the bot. Everyone currently in that voice channel can use it. Natural voices support English, Dutch, French and German; choose with `/tts languages`.

# HUSS HQ — Logistics updates
**2/4 — Stockpiles, orders & shipping**

**Stockpiles**
• Shared panels open a private browser showing only stockpiles you can access. Member and officer-only visibility are supported.
• Select stockpiles by name/location instead of repeatedly entering IDs. Inventory views include filters, pagination and reported reserve timers.
• **Import contents** accepts a stockpile export uploaded directly to Discord. Review the preview and confirm before inventory is changed.
• Reserve stockpiles require an access code at creation. Codes are shown privately only to authorised logistics staff and are not included in public panels.

**Orders**
• Use the order panel or `/order view` to find, claim and update work. Item autocomplete helps select exact Foxhole item names.
• Production orders create new goods and do not require a source stockpile. Transport and supply orders can link sources and destinations.
• Record pickups, production, partial deliveries and returns. Deliveries to a linked destination update its recorded stockpile contents.

**Shipping manifests**
• `/manifest` groups orders into truck, freighter, train or convoy shipments with a route, leader and crew.
• Members can join as crew, driver or escort and open the linked cargo orders.
• Departure and completion track shipment progress without deducting inventory a second time.

**Cargo loss reporting**
Report lost cargo from an order, with its quantity and reason/location. Losses are recorded separately from deliveries. Orders and shipments with losses close as **Completed with losses**, not Delivered.

**Connected panels**
Open stockpile, order and manifest browsers refresh after logistics changes and recheck access. Reopen after a restart or an expired session.

All inventory, timers and movements are **manually reported**. The bot does not read live Foxhole stockpiles, move goods or convert units.

# HUSS HQ — Regiment & war updates
**3/4 — Squads, training, honours & Able tracking**

**Squads**
• Create squads under Logistics, Facility or Frontline, with Army, Navy and Air branches. Creation requires department leadership or Commander approval.
• Browse the directory, view rosters and goals, request to join, accept invitations or leave.
• Leaders manage recruitment, membership, descriptions and leadership transfers. Goal changes and squad deletion follow the existing approval process; previous goals are retained.
• Squad leadership does not grant Officer permissions. There are no squad membership or production caps.

**Training and qualifications**
• Training requirements and qualification checks use the configured qualification roles.
• Trainers and authorised officers use `/certify` to record an assessment. A training signup does not award a qualification, and self-certification is blocked.
• `/memberinfo` brings together rank, qualifications, squad membership, accepted event RSVPs and honours.

**Regiment commendations**
• Nominate members or squads for regiment awards and browse approved awards in the Hall of Honours.
• Officers can request more information, approve or reject nominations, and retain a history of corrections and revocations.
• The Winged Hussar’s Cross requires two independent officer approvals. Awards do not grant ranks or permissions.
• Honours summaries and HUSS crimson, charcoal and gold artwork are included.

**Able war lifecycle**
• Confirmed war ends produce a summary. New wars receive a new kill-count campaign while completed records are retained.
• A Commander must approve the activity check. Members always receive a full **48 hours** to respond.
• Rollover requires both the response window and at least 48 hours since war end to have passed, followed by a separate Commander preview and confirmation.
• `/warreport` connects reported regiment activity to the tracked war. Unknown historical war labels are not guessed.

# HUSS HQ — Officer & reliability updates
**4/4 — Administration, permissions & health**

**Officer tools**
• The admin dashboard groups recruitment reviews, events, war management, logistics and configuration. Navigation opens private staff views.
• `/feedback queue` and `/feedback update` let officers mark reports **Investigating**, **Planned** or **Resolved**. Reporters can check their own updates.
• `/absence list` shows return notices; Commander rollover previews highlight absent members who have not responded.
• `/setup-check` checks configuration and permissions. `/auditlog` shows recorded administrative changes.

**Ranks and warnings**
• Only Officers and Commanders can promote: Officers up to **Hussar**, Commanders up to **Officer**. Ordinary members and Dragoons do not gain promotion rights.
• One eligible oldest warning expires after 30 days, with at least 30 days between removals. The old officer-voting removal policy is retired.
• Shared role-ID checks make permissions more consistent across features.

**Clearer bot status**
Grouped features, availability counts, maintenance details and officer diagnostics.
🟢 Working / available
🟡 Maintenance, delays or Discord throttling
🟣 Errors detected
🔴 Down / unavailable

**Better health monitoring**
• `/health` shows response timing, safe request-error categories, reminder and panel failures, TTS queues and storage status.
• `/healthalerts status` shows grouped officer alerts. Repeated problems trigger private alerts, with a recovery notice after consecutive clean checks.
• Discord rate limits are tracked separately from failed requests.

**Reliability fixes**
Duplicated commands and duplicate panel-button IDs were addressed. Ticket closure preserves transcripts, destructive actions use confirmations, and activity deadlines survive restarts.

**Getting started:** use `/hub view` or `/onboarding view`. Officers can post `/hub panel`. Refresh existing status panels for the current layout.
